guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Financial Outlook
section: The company raised its full-year financial outlook:
•Reported sales growth from continuing operations: 4% to 5% (previously 3% to 4%)
•Organic sales growth from continuing operations: 3% to 4% (previously 2% to 3%)
•Adjusted earnings from continuing operations per diluted share: $2.05 to $2.15 (previously $1.95 to $2.15)
See the "Non-GAAP Financial Measures" section for explanations of the company’s non-GAAP financial measures.
